sections.text: مقدمة

This document lists the equipment inspection I1, to be performed every six 
months or 'when damages occur on any part of it' as indicated by M6 in the title block

This crane is used for lifting and lowering draft tube gate of main turbine 
 unites
Technical specifications:

Carried capacity : 88 ton Hoist speed : 1.3 m / 
 min.

Crane travel speed : 6.7 m / min. Wheel base : 20 m. 
 Span : 5.4 m.

The first draft initiated by eng. Ashraf Saber Ibrahem, tested by eng. Mohamed Hafez 
 Abdel-Meniem, 
 checked by general director eng. Abdel Ghaffar Osman,
 revised by HPGC 
quality control eng. Kamel Ragheb, and approved by eng. Mohamed Abd 
 Elbast; Head Sector of Aswan 1 & 2 Power Station

السلامة 
الاحتياطات

A 
work permit must be issued and the qualified 
maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with 
caution marks surrounding the work area.
Wear safety helmet, shoes, belts, work gloves
Turn off all power to crane before proceeding.

أدوات 
والمعدات
Personal safety equipment, safety goggles, and rubber gloves and rubber apron.
Mobilgear 634 oil , Esso surrett Nx 5k gears
Torque wrench, wrench with different sizes, pressure grease gun and feeler gauge
Cleaning articles ( fluid, rags ... etc )

items: Personal safety equipment, safety goggles, and rubber gloves and rubber apron.
Mobilgear 634 oil , Esso surrett Nx 5k gears
Torque wrench, wrench with different sizes, pressure grease gun and feeler gauge

sections.text: العمل الذي يتعين القيام به

Check brake lining for wear and tear and if 2 mm thick above or under rivets 
 should be changed.
Examine the chain and grease it with Esso surrett Nx 5k grease
Check oil level of gear boxes and refill if necessary with Mobilgear 634 oil
Inspect and check tightness of bolts, nuts.
Examine the condition of flanges and anti-friction bearing seals

Examine the structure steel works for rust or corrosion and repainted if 
 necessary
تحقق من الحلقات والبطانات بحثًا عن البلى
Check tightness of coupling, screws

Examine gears for main hoist, axial travel and cross travel which in open 
 boxes and grease it with Esso surrett Nx 5k grease.
